about: What the screenshot gallery should show. capture.mjs reads this, writes shots/<id>/<theme>-<width>.png, and updates each entry's status. Screens are captured against the deterministic mock API (ui/scripts/e2e-api.mjs), never a real Worlds: this repo is public.

entries.title: Bridge (home)
entries.caption: The Bridge: the guide's briefing, the rooms as doorways, and what needs you.
entries.alt: The Worlds Bridge with a briefing at the top and room doorway cards below.

entries.title: A room's drawer (Studio)
entries.caption: Looking inside a room: its status in words, its cards, and what needs you, with links that open on the room's own site.
entries.alt: The Studio room drawer open over the Bridge.

entries.title: Workshop drawer with Secrets
entries.caption: The Workshop room's drawer, including the owner-only Secrets section: names and health only, never a value.
entries.alt: The Workshop room drawer showing a Secrets section with station health and key names.

entries.title: Memory
entries.caption: Memory: your journal and records, and finding things in them.
entries.alt: The Memory screen listing journal entries.

entries.title: Chat
entries.caption: Chat with your guide. Read-only: it observes, and anything it wants to change becomes a proposal you approve.

entries.title: Settings
entries.caption: Settings: voice and tone, companion, theme, and the way into Crew.

entries.title: Crew
entries.caption: Crew: choose your companion, and put a keeper and a doorway on each room.
entries.alt: The Crew screen with companions and per-room keepers.
entries.notes: If the Settings screen's way into Crew has a different accessible name, fix the step, not the UI.

entries.title: Interests (moving to Candy)
entries.caption: Interests: discovery as it lives in Worlds today, before it moves to the Candy room.

entries.title: Projects (parked)
entries.caption: A parked area: an honest placeholder, never pretend data.

entries.title: First Light (first-run setup)
entries.caption: First Light: the first-run setup, with crew on or off and a companion choice.
entries.notes: Server-rendered: not served by the preview build or the mock API. Capture from a throwaway local Worlds with a fresh data dir, or leave wanted.

entries.title: Sign in
entries.caption: Sign in: passkey-first when an identity provider is configured, with the access code as a fallback.
entries.notes: Server-rendered, like First Light. Use a throwaway local Worlds; never the owner's.
